verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a payroll and HR platform with a public API and CLI, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents bulk or batch actions across many items. The pack covers individual API endpoints, pagination, webhooks, an MCP server and CLI commands, and custom report generation, none of which is a documented capability to act on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
